summary.text: Delegating a wallet's voting power gives it to a DRep you choose, or records it as Abstain or No Confidence. Daedalus asks you to register your voting power this way so that you can withdraw staking rewards, and the Governance Center shows what each of your wallets delegates to.

problem.text: You want to delegate a wallet's voting power to a DRep, to Abstain or to No Confidence, or change where it is delegated.

symptoms.text: The Governance Center shows a wallet as Undelegated.
Daedalus says to register your voting power to withdraw rewards.

user_phrases.text: How do I delegate my voting power?
How do I choose a DRep?

errors.verbatim: This wallet does not contain the minimum required amount of ADA. The wallet might still be syncing. Please try again later or choose another wallet.
errors.normalized: wallet does not contain the minimum required amount of ada

errors.verbatim: This wallet already delegates to this choice. Please change delegation in order to proceed.
errors.normalized: wallet already delegates to this choice

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

resolutions.why: Governance opens on the Governance Center.

resolutions.action: In the Governance Center, select Delegate next to the wallet, or Redelegate if the wallet already delegates its voting power.
resolutions.why: The button opens the Directory with that wallet selected.

resolutions.action: To delegate to a particular DRep, enter its DRep ID or name in Search by DRep ID or name, or pick one from Suggested DReps.
resolutions.why: The Directory lists and searches registered DReps.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus shows Invalid DRep ID, check the ID and enter it again.
resolutions.why: Daedalus checks a complete DRep ID before it searches for it.

resolutions.action: Select Delegate for the DRep you chose. To choose Abstain or No Confidence instead, select Select on that option's card under Or choose a predefined option.
resolutions.why: The choice is carried to the delegation form.

resolutions.action: Check the wallet under Delegate From and your choice under Delegate To, and select Submit.
If Daedalus says the wallet does not contain the minimum required amount of ADA, the wallet might still be syncing. Select Submit again later, or choose another wallet under Delegate From.
resolutions.why: Daedalus gives this error when the wallet cannot fund the transaction, and notes that the wallet might still be syncing.
The fee is paid from the wallet.

resolutions.action: With a software wallet, enter your spending password in Confirm Transaction and select Confirm. If Daedalus shows Review transaction instead, enter the password there and select Sign and send.
resolutions.why: Confirming sends the delegation transaction. Builds with the CIP-30 dApp connector show Review transaction instead of Confirm Transaction.

resolutions.action: With a hardware wallet, confirm the transaction on the device, then select Confirm in Confirm Transaction. If Daedalus shows Review transaction instead, select Continue on device and send, then confirm on the device.
resolutions.why: Confirm stays disabled until the device has confirmed the transaction; Review transaction passes the transaction to the device.

expected_outcome.text: Daedalus sends the delegation transaction and opens the wallet's Summary.

prerequisites: Daedalus has finished synchronizing with the Cardano blockchain. Until then, the delegation form is not available.
consequences: The fee shown under Transaction fee is paid from the wallet.
Delegating to Abstain records your stake on chain as not participating in governance.
Delegating to No Confidence counts your stake as Yes on every motion of no confidence and as No on every other governance action.
recovery: To change the choice later, select Redelegate next to the wallet in the Governance Center.

evidence.rationale: Read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text; source inspection, not runtime testing.
